$comment: Component-tier geometry tokens that deliberately diverge from the control
The default answer is NO exception: a value more than one component uses
belongs in control/<step>/<property>. An entry here is a design decision on
the record, not a shortcut — if you cannot write the reason, it is not one.

exceptions.reason: Tabs sit in a denser horizontal rhythm than buttons; Figma Tabs Item 156:259 uses 20px at Medium and Large where Button uses 24px. Confirmed against the design file, not inferred.
Same as tabs/medium/icon/size — Tabs' icon does not grow past 20px.
